documents.unit: University of Houston System, Information Security
documents.title: Usage of Artificial Intelligence at UHS
documents.quality_note: System IT/security guidance on tool and data use; its only academic line sends readers to their university provost.

notes: No UH academic-affairs AI policy located. uh.edu/ai/resources/policy.php is a stub linking to the UHS page. The Academic Honesty Policy page and NSM Code of Honor have no AI text. The provost links 'Sample Syllabi Policies for AI Generative Tools' to a third-party crowd-sourced Google Doc (Lance Eaton), not UH policy, so not collected. No CS department AI policy found; seed COSC 4368 syllabus is course-layer, deferred. This is a weak result: a reviewer may want to hunt for the UH provost's AI teaching guidance.
